description: Excellent - A trustworthy source backed by strong analysis or direct measurements.
Good - Trustworthy source. Partly based on assumptions or imperfect analysis.
Acceptable - Acceptable source. May rely on many assumptions, shallow analysis, or rough measurement.
Lacking - Questionable or unverified source. Poorly measured or weak analysis.
Unacceptable - No or untrustworthy source. Unsupported assumption.
